reasons.plausibility: The proposed approach of hydride precursor 3D printing with controlled oxygen uptake, subsequent densification, phase stabilization via quenching, and a protective coating is scientifically coherent with known HEA processing methods and oxidation-mitigation strategies, though it involves several complex steps simultaneously.
reasons.testability: In-situ XRD and post-sintering/quench characterization offer a clear path to verify the phase structures, oxidation behavior, and mechanical properties, providing a feasible test to confirm or refute the hypothesis.
reasons.usefulness: The proposed method addresses both oxidation resistance and mechanical performance, offering a distinct route that, if confirmed, would be valuable for extending the high-temperature usability of this alloy system.
